seasons.name: Monster High
seasons.plot: Teenager Clawdeen Wolf never felt like she fit in, until her instincts led her to Monster High, where she discovered she’s a werewolf and a human, and now feels at home in both worlds. She is befriended by Draculaura, Frankie Stein and Deuce Gorgon. These young monsters are learning who they are, defying expectations, disrupting the norm, and embracing their differences to make a difference. Together, they’ll learn to be fierce and fearless at the one place they all belong: Monster High.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Draculaura practices witchcraft, and Clawdeen and Frankie must help her subdue the tater tot she brought to life!

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Frankie, "cursed" from their brain's past life, gets help from Clawdeen and Draculaura to break it.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: On her birthday, monster expert Clawdeen receives her mother's necklace from her father. It guides her to a hidden school called Monster High.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: To evade monster hunters, Clawdeen must embrace her human side to save herself and Cleo.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Frankie's picture day panic causes them to ZAP the school camera into a soul-sucking menace.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Toralei and Lagoona threaten to expose Draculaura as a witch, sabotaging her campaign to be Head Fearleader.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Clawdeen's friendship with Frankie and Draculaura is tested when she's invited to join Monster High's werewolf pack.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Deuce overworks himself to win a fundraiser, accidentally turning other students into rock candy treats.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Clawdeen opens up to her dad and learns they have a lot in common, while Cleo seeks followers in the human world.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: To discover the cause of her mother's disappearance, Clawdeen opens a portal in the catacombs and releases her brother Clawd.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Draculaura is set on hosting the perfect holiday party. But someone unexpected shows up and things don't go as planned, she struggles to cope with unmet expectations and sharing the spotlight.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: Afraid to be embarrassed at a dance-off, Draculaura gives her partner, Clawd, enchanted dancing shoes.

episodes.name: Episodio 13
episodes.plot: Cleo wants the lead role for the school play and raids her family's ancient tomb for a perfect, superior costume.
